review.assessment: This change replaces the hardcoded check for `DONE` and `FAILED` with a call to `st.is_terminal()`. By treating all terminal statuses (including the new `CANCELLED`) as finished at their recorded end time, the SLA clock stops when the operator cancels the job instead of continuing to accrue until now. This directly fixes the operations complaint about cancelled jobs falsely triggering SLA violations, and the acceptance suite confirms correct behavior across the updated logic.
